name: phase3-differential-evolution
description: Phase 3 closure benchmark of DE/rand/1/bin@1 with its literature defaults (NP = 10 D, F = 0.5, CR = 0.9). Scenarios, budgets, seeds, thresholds and acceptance criteria were fixed on 2026-11-10, before the first execution. Test functions (RV-3.02): standard forms on asymmetric boxes, so the optimum is not the box centre; budget 10^4 D evaluations and accuracy level 1e-8, the convention of the CEC 2005 real-parameter benchmark (the functions here are not shifted or rotated, so results are not comparable with that suite). Transfers (RV-3.01, RV-3.04): coplanar circular orbits with the Hohmann transfer as reference; budget 10^3 D evaluations, a tenth of the function budget because each evaluation propagates a trajectory; success threshold 1 m/s, the practical convergence threshold of the Phase 3 design; a run better than the reference by more than 1e-6 m/s is an anomaly.
